subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: We observe 21 February as Shaheed Dibosh throughout the country every year in memory of the martyrs of the language movement in 1952. People wear black badges and go to the Shaheed Minar in barefoot processions singing mourning song "Amar Bhaier Rokte Rangano…." Various programmes are arranged too. The UNESCO proclaimed February 21 as the International Mother Language Day in recognition of their sacrifice. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 197
